target_a_text.mechanism: Content stream token rewriting & vector block injection

target_b_annotations.mechanism: Bounding-box intersection scan and /Annots array culling

target_c_metadata.limitation_note: Tool 16 is scoped to page content streams and annotations. Metadata sanitization is handled independently via Module E Tool 28.

target_d_raster_images.limitation_note: Redaction draws an opaque vector mask over image coordinates in the content stream. The underlying raw image stream in /Resources/XObject is retained. Full pixel-level image destruction requires external image rasterization.

target_e_embedded_content.limitation_note: Neither Tool 16 nor Tool 28 currently unbinds document-level /EmbeddedFiles attachment dictionaries.
